name: Blistering Insurgent gets +1 power on the champion's first attack each turn
notes: Blistering Insurgent's element is FIRE, matched by the default starting champion (Spirit of Fire), so no lineage patch is needed. The champion has 0 printed power (it normally attacks via an equipped weapon), so its Counters are patched with a 'potion_animate_power' override to give it positive power without needing to also equip and select a weapon during the attack declaration. Per Rule 1.h the first player can't attack on turn 1, so both players end their turn once (P1 -> P2 -> P1) to reach turn 3; entering a new turn opens a material-phase MZMAYCHOOSE (whether to materialize from the material deck) that is declined with a PASS before the main phase becomes available. Blistering Insurgent is then materialized (no [Class Bonus] discount, full 2-reserve cost) and the champion declares an attack (mode 10002 FSM on myField-0) against the opposing champion; the trigger fires as soon as the attack is declared, tagging Blistering Insurgent's TurnEffects with the +1 power effect, independent of how the rest of combat resolves.

rulesClauses: Whenever your champion attacks for the first time each turn, CARDNAME gets +1[POWER] until end of turn.
